features.title: Bardic Inspiration
features.body:
You can supernaturally inspire others through words, music, or dance, represented by your Bardic Inspiration die (a d6).


Using Bardic Inspiration. As a Bonus Action, inspire a creature within 60 feet that can see or hear you. That creature gains one Bardic Inspiration die. Once within the next hour, when the creature fails a D20 Test, it can roll the die and add it to the d20, potentially turning a failure into a success. The die is expended when rolled.


Number of Uses. You can confer a Bardic Inspiration die a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum once), regaining all uses on a Long Rest.


At Higher Levels. The die becomes a d8 at level 5, a d10 at level 10, and a d12 at level 15.

features.title: Spellcasting
features.body:
You have learned to cast spells through your bardic arts. Charisma is your spellcasting ability and you can use a Musical Instrument as a Spellcasting Focus.


cantripss. You know two cantripss of your choice from the Lights and Vicious Mockery are recommended. You gain more cantripss at levels 4 and 10.


Prepared Spells. Choose four level 1 spells from the . The number increases as you gain levels. Charm Person, Color Spray, Dissonant Whispers, and Healing Word are recommended.

features.title: Expertise
features.body: You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice. Performance and Persuasion are recommended. At Bard level 9, you gain Expertise in two more skills.

features.title: Jack of All Trades
features.body: You can add half your Proficiency Bonus (round down) to any ability check you make that uses a skill proficiency you lack and that doesn't otherwise use your Proficiency Bonus.
